titles.native: セーラー戦士 ヴィーナス♡ファイブ

description:
A struggle between two old gods continues on in the modern age. On the side of justice and the goddess Aphrodite is Venus 5, a team of beautiful lady warriors who can wrap up any battle with a happy ending. In the name of their goddess, they punish the followers of the god Apollo, their ancient and naughty, naughty enemy. But winning a war is never easy, and the lovely women in Aphrodite's sailor-suited fivesome have to beat off more than their fair share of tentacled villains in order to save the day.

(Source: Kitty Media)
